content: Cognitive capacity is a critical factor in the effective management of diabetes. It enables individuals to make informed decisions regarding their self-care and facilitates collaboration with healthcare providers. When cognitive decline is identified, integrating a lay care professional into the diabetes care team can be advantageous. This professional can assist with daily monitoring and act as a liaison between the patient and the broader care team. For youth with diabetes, second-party support from parents or adult caregivers is often necessary until they reach a developmental stage where they can comprehend and act upon essential diabetes management information independently.
